name: Street Vendor Simulator
description: Step into the shoes of a street water vendor at a busy traffic light: buy bottles of water, set prices based on the flow of cars, and sell to drivers waiting for the light to change. Manage your inventory, observe traffic patterns, and maximize your earnings at every stop. Use your profits to buy everything you’ve always dreamed of, all while learning to analyze demand and make strategic decisions in the fast-paced chaos of city traffic.
